reference.title: Encrypted hashed passwords
reference.shortdesc: Passwords are encrypted in addition to being hashed.

section.p: A station with encrypted hashed passwords will not run in or earlier. To downgrade the station, you must revert the station using the BOG File Protection tool. For more information, see "Reverting station for compatibility".
Station user passwords are encrypted and hashed on all platforms.This feature does not apply to platform users.
